description: Create a Locker install for the any-HTTP connector (platform http: a script, Pipedream, Power Automate, anything that posts JSON with the install key) or for this agent (platform agent: no key, the session is the principal). Returns where the key is, never the key: by default the server writes it into the owner's project vault as LOCKER_INSTALL_KEY_{SLUG} so a pipe can use it as $secrets.NAME, and the human reads it once on keyPageUrl. The first install on an account installs Locker on its free allowance (250 runs over 14 days); say so to your human, since a new aside entry appeared. Zapier, Make and n8n installs are created by their own connectors, not here.

name.description: What the installer calls it: the client, the workflow, the script.

storeKeyAsSecret.description: Default true. False for a script that will hold the key itself (a vault slot nobody uses would be spent for nothing).
